title: Multi-Transport Inverse-Variance Packet Striping
prompt: Given three physical network interfaces with observed Round Trip Times RTT_TB4 = 0.27ms, RTT_WG = 1.85ms, and RTT_WiFi = 4.20ms, calculate the optimal normalized inverse-variance traffic striping weights w_i = (1 / RTT_i^2) / Sum(1 / RTT_j^2). Provide the closed-form equation, intermediate variance computations, and exact percentage weights.
criteria: Accurate inverse variance calculation, correct normalization sum, clear LaTeX mathematical formatting.

title: 512Hz Pan-Tompkins QRS Derivative & Kamath 2004 Artifact Filter
prompt: Explain how a 5-point derivative filter H(z) = (1/8T)(-z^-2 - 2z^-1 + 2z^1 + z^2) detects steep R-peaks in 512Hz raw Movesense ECG data, and formulate the Kamath 2004 20% clinical RR-interval artifact rejection criterion for autonomic HRV computation.
criteria: Correct discrete-time transfer function explanation, Kamath 2004 mathematical bound formula, zero synthetic mock data assumptions.

title: Thunderbolt 4 DMA Ring Buffer & Zero-Copy Tensor Sharding
prompt: Architect a zero-copy circular ring buffer for sharding GGML GGUF quantization weights across a 10Gbps/40Gbps Thunderbolt 4 bridge (0.27ms RTT) between an Apple M4 Pro host and an M1 Max peripheral node without user-space memcpy overhead.
criteria: POSIX shared memory / mmap semantics, lock-free producer-consumer pointer management, sub-millisecond tensor pipeline integrity.

title: Apple Silicon Metal Compute Shader for 120 FPS Tatami Kinematics
prompt: Write a complete Metal Shading Language (MSL) kernel in Swift/C++ that computes 33-landmark MediaPipe joint torque vectors in parallel and binds the output buffer directly to a WebGPU / Three.js 10m x 10m tatami canvas running at 120 FPS.
criteria: Syntactically valid MSL kernel code, simd::float3 vector math, threadgroup memory optimization.

title: OpenWrt SQM fq_codel Defense vs BQL Buffer Exhaustion
prompt: An adversarial red faction agent is injecting 64MB socket probe floods into TCP Port 50052 to induce bufferbloat on GL-MT3600BE. Formulate the exact Linux tc qdisc command and sysctl TCP window clamp parameters to ensure packet jitter remains bounded under 0.15ms.
criteria: Precise tc qdisc fq_codel syntax, correct target/interval parameter selection, BQL queue clamp mechanism.
